title: What Happens If You Shift Into Reverse While Driving
hook: Never shift into reverse while moving.

script.narration: Never shift into reverse while moving.
script.visual_search: manual gear shifter close up in car

script.narration: Modern automatic and manual transmissions have safety lockouts, but forcing a car into reverse at speed creates massive mechanical shock. It can instantly shred your transmission gears and destroy your driveshaft.

script.narration: Like if this helped, follow for daily car tips. Have you ever accidentally mis-shifted? Comment below, because never shift into reverse while moving.
